subject: The one mistake 90% of users make with AI notes
preview_text: It's not about the AI. It's about the 5 seconds before you hit record. This changes everything.
body_paragraphs: I watched a user test yesterday that made me cringe. Brilliant project manager. Important client call. She opened Smart Notes, hit record, and leaned back. And she missed the single most powerful thing the app can do for her. It's the same thing most people skip. It takes 5 seconds. It makes the AI 10x smarter.

Here's the secret: The AI isn't a mind reader. It's a context reader. When you just hit record and say nothing, you're asking it to work blindfolded. But when you give it one sentence—just one—before the meeting starts, you unlock a different app. You tell it 'This is a weekly sprint planning with the dev team' or 'This is a negotiation call with a vendor about pricing.' You whisper the agenda. You hand it the map. Suddenly, it doesn't just transcribe words. It understands meaning. It highlights the right decisions. It spots the real action items. It's the difference between a transcript and a strategic asset.

That tiny text box at the top before you hit the big red button? That's your secret weapon. It's called the 'Meeting Context' field. Most people ignore it. The pros use it every single time. Type one line. Just one. 'Budget approval meeting with finance.' 'Brainstorm for Q3 marketing campaign.' 'One-on-one with Sarah about career growth.' Give the AI its marching orders. Watch it perform magic.

Your tiny commitment today: Open Smart Notes before your next meeting. Any meeting. Type one sentence in that top box. Then hit record. Do it once and feel the difference. The summary won't just be accurate—it will be insightful. Try this now. P.S. The users who do this? They're the ones saving 5+ hours a week. They look prepared. They sound brilliant. They never miss a thing. This is how you join them.
cta_text: Open Smart Notes & Set Your Context
